body.zh-Hant: 喬治亞國家科學院編纂的《喬治亞百科全書》與德國國家圖書館權威檔都記載，尼古洛茲（卡爾洛）·齊赫澤生於1864年。百科全書稱他是喬治亞與俄羅斯的政治人物、著名的社會民主黨人，也是喬治亞與俄羅斯孟什維克主義的領導人之一。他曾就讀新俄羅斯大學物理數學系，但因積極參與學生運動而被開除，未能完成學業。
body.en: The Georgian Encyclopedia of the Georgian National Academy of Sciences and the German National Library authority file both record that Nikoloz (Carlo) Chkheidze was born in 1864. The encyclopedia calls him a Georgian and Russian politician, a well-known Social Democrat and one of the leaders of Georgian and Russian Menshevism. He studied at the Faculty of Physics and Mathematics of Novorossiysk University but was expelled for his active involvement in the student movement and could not finish his studies.

heading.zh-Hant: 俄羅斯國家杜馬與彼得格勒蘇維埃
heading.en: The State Duma and the Petrograd Soviet

body.zh-Hant: 百科全書記載，齊赫澤自1907年起在第比利斯選區當選，成為俄羅斯第三屆與第四屆國家杜馬議員，並擔任杜馬中孟什維克黨團的領袖。1917年2月至8月二月革命之後，他擔任彼得格勒工兵代表蘇維埃主席，並為國務會議成員；德國權威檔也記有1917年任工兵蘇維埃主席。十月革命之前，他返回喬治亞。
body.en: The encyclopedia records that from 1907 Chkheidze was elected from the Tbilisi electoral province as a member of the third and fourth Russian State Duma and led the Menshevik group there. From February to August 1917, after the February Revolution, he was chairman of the Petrograd Council of workers' and soldiers' deputies and a member of the State Council; the German authority file likewise notes his 1917 chairmanship of the workers' and soldiers' councils. Before the October Revolution he returned to Georgia.

body.zh-Hant: 百科全書記載，齊赫澤1918年當選外高加索議會（Seim）主席，1919至1921年擔任喬治亞立憲會議主席。1921年喬治亞被併吞後，他移居法國，五年後自殺，葬於巴黎的拉雪茲神父公墓；德國權威檔同樣記有1921年流亡。
body.en: The encyclopedia records that in 1918 Chkheidze was elected chairman of the Seim (Council) of Transcaucasia and that in 1919-21 he was chairman of the Constituent Assembly of Georgia. After the annexation of Georgia in 1921 he emigrated to France and five years later committed suicide; he was buried at the Pere Lachaise cemetery in Paris. The German authority file likewise notes his emigration in 1921.

people.name: Thomas Madsen-Mygdal
people.nameZh: 托馬斯·馬德森-米格達爾

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與達盧姆農業學校
heading.en: Origins and the Dalum agricultural school

body.zh-Hant: 《丹麥人物傳記辭典》記載，托馬斯·馬德森-米格達爾生於1876年12月24日，卒於1943年2月23日，是政治家與農場主。他在耶靈師範學校取得教師資格，1902年自農業高等學校畢業，取得農業候選人資格；1907年被召回達盧姆（Dalum），1908至1920年擔任該校校長。
body.en: The Dansk Biografisk Leksikon records that Thomas Madsen-Mygdal was born on 24 December 1876 and died on 23 February 1943, a minister and farmer. He took a teacher's examination at Jelling seminary, passed his examination as a graduate in agriculture at the agricultural college in 1902, was called back to Dalum in 1907, and was head of the school there in 1908-20.

citations.quote: Thomas Madsen-Mygdal, 24.12.1876-23.2.1943, minister, landmand.
tog lærereksamen fra Jelling seminarium
kom han til landbohøjskolen og tog 1902 eksamen som landbrugskandidat
kaldte ham 1907 tilbage til Dalum
1908-20 var Thomas Madsen-Mygdal skolens myndige og dygtige leder

heading.en: Farm-organisation leader and entry into government

body.zh-Hant: 1918年他當選丹麥農會聯合會主席，1919年出任新設的農業理事會（landbrugsråd）主席；不久後他辭去這些主席職務。1920年5月4日他入閣，在尼爾斯·尼爾高（Niels Neergaard）的自由黨（Venstre）政府擔任農業部長；丹麥政府部會的歷任部長名單則記其任期為1920年5月5日至1924年4月23日。同年8月，他由自由黨在菲因島選入上議院。
body.en: In 1918 he was elected chairman of the Danish farmers' associations and in 1919 president of the newly created agricultural council (landbrugsråd); shortly afterwards he gave up these chairmanships. He entered the Venstre government of Niels Neergaard as minister of agriculture on 4 May 1920, while the Danish ministry's list of former ministers gives his term as 5 May 1920 to 23 April 1924. In August of the same year he was elected to the Landsting by Venstre on Funen.

Kort efter nedlagde han sine formandshverv
indtrådte som landbrugsminister i venstreregeringen Niels Neergaard 4.5.1920

heading.zh-Hant: 離開上議院與重返政壇
heading.en: Leaving the Landsting and returning to politics

body.zh-Hant: 1922年11月8日，他在丹麥議會下院（Folketing）批評保守黨的工業政策，說農業從不想躲在關稅壁壘之後。1925年2月他辭去上議院議席；1926年11月他被推為南日德蘭（Sønderjylland）的候選人，並於12月2日當選。
body.en: On 8 November 1922 he took on the Conservatives' industrial policy in the Folketing, saying agriculture had never wished to shelter behind tariff walls. In February 1925 he gave up his Landsting seat; in November 1926 he was chosen as candidate in Sønderjylland and was elected on 2 December.

Landbruget havde aldrig ønsket at krybe i ly bag toldmure

Dermed var Thomas Madsen-Mygdal kåret til kandidat i Sønderjylland
Sønderjylland hvor han valgtes 2.12.

heading.en: Prime minister and the fall of the government

body.zh-Hant: 他於1926年12月14日組成自由黨與保守黨多數政府。1927年克朗恢復黃金兌換；政府以降低工資與社會支出的方式縮減公共開支。他拒絕為較高的克朗價值調整國防預算，保守黨因此在1929年3月21日的財政法案表決中撤回支持，政府淪為少數並提前舉行選舉。
body.en: On 14 December 1926 he formed a government on a majority of Venstre and the Conservatives. In 1927 the krone's convertibility into gold was reintroduced, and public spending was cut through lower wages and social expenditure. The Conservatives withdrew their support in the vote on the finance bill on 21 March 1929, which left the government in a minority and led to an election.

citations.quote: 14.12.1926 dannede han regering på flertal af venstre og konservative.
1927 indførtes kronens guldindløselighed
Det skete gennem nedsættelse af lønninger og sociale udgifter
unddrog de konservative ham støtte ved afstemning om finansloven 21.3.1929
Regeringen kom i mindretal og udskrev valg.
i 1929 blev regeringen væltet

body.zh-Hant: 1929年選舉後，社會民主黨與激進自由黨組成多數政府，馬德森-米格達爾成為自由黨議會黨團與全國組織主席。1933年8月5日他辭去下院議席，1938年出任東亞工業與種植公司董事長，1941年辭去自由黨全國組織主席職務。
body.en: After the election the Social Democrats and the Radicals formed a majority government and Madsen-Mygdal became chairman of the Venstre parliamentary group and national organisation. On 5 August 1933 he gave up his seat in the Folketing, in 1938 he became chairman of the East Asiatic Industrial and Plantation Company, and in 1941 he gave up the chairmanship of the Venstre national organisation.

people.name: António Maria da Silva
people.nameZh: 安東尼奧·馬里亞·達席爾瓦

body.zh-Hant: 葡萄牙共和國議會網站的出版物介紹記載，安東尼奧·馬里亞·達席爾瓦（1872–1950）本業是礦業工程師，後來成為葡萄牙燒炭黨（Carbonária）的領導人之一；其密謀活動促成1910年10月5日革命的勝利與共和國的建立，使他成為新政權的奠基者之一。德國國家圖書館權威檔同樣記他生於1872年。
body.en: A publication note on the website of the Portuguese Assembleia da República records that António Maria da Silva (1872-1950) was a mining engineer by training who became one of the leaders of the Portuguese Carbonária; its conspiratorial effort secured the victory of the revolution of 5 October 1910 and the establishment of the Republic, making him one of the founders of the new regime. The German National Library authority file likewise gives his birth year as 1872.

citations.evidenceNote: 引文「5 de Outubro」，同句下接「de 1910」

heading.zh-Hant: 共和國第一階段與部長職務
heading.en: The Republic's first phase and ministerial posts

body.zh-Hant: 議會介紹稱，在共和國第一階段（1910–1917），他先以獨立人士、後以葡萄牙共和黨／民主黨成員身分，主持阿方索·科斯塔前兩屆政府的工務（Fomento）部；葡萄牙參戰後，他在神聖聯盟政府擔任勞工部長。1915年5月14日，他參加推翻皮門塔·德卡斯特羅獨裁的革命委員會。
body.en: The parliamentary note says that in the Republic's first phase (1910-1917) he, first as an independent and then as a member of the Portuguese Republican Party, led the Ministry of Fomento in Afonso Costa's first two governments; after Portugal entered the war he joined the Sacred Union government as minister of labour. On 14 May 1915 he played one of the main roles in the revolutionary junta that overthrew the dictatorship of Pimenta de Castro.

citations.quote: Durante a primeira fase da República (1910-1917)
primeiro como independente, depois como membro do Partido Republicano
liderado o Ministério do Fomento nos dois primeiros governos de Afonso Costa
integrou o governo da União Sagrada como ministro do Trabalho
foi apenas no 14 de Maio de 1915 que teve um dos papéis principais
Junta Revolucionária responsável pelo derrube da ditadura
ditadura de Pimenta de Castro

heading.en: Withdrawal and leadership of the Democratic Party

body.zh-Hant: 議會介紹稱，1917年中至1919年中他淡出政壇；到1922年初為止，他是民主黨領導層中最重要的人物，也是共和國影響力最大的政治人物。他六度出任部長會議主席，並當選共和國時期除西多尼奧（Sidónio Pais）時期外的歷屆國會議員。
body.en: The parliamentary note says he stayed out of the limelight between mid-1917 and mid-1919; until early 1922 he established himself as the most important figure in the leadership of the Democratic Party and so as the most influential politician of the Republic. He was president of the Ministry on six occasions and was elected deputy in every legislature of the Republic except that of the Sidonist period.

citations.quote: Entre meados de 1917 e meados de 1919
permaneceu afastado da ribalta
Até aos inícios de 1922, conseguiu afirmar-se como a figura mais importante
como o político mais influente
foi presidente do Ministério por seis ocasiões
foi eleito deputado em todas as legislaturas da República
exceto na do período sidonista

body.zh-Hant: 議會介紹稱，他在共和國大部分時期主持郵政電報總局，致力在葡萄牙建立無線電報網，並促成1925年葡萄牙馬可尼無線電公司的成立；他也在1915年12月至1929年12月間擔任共濟會副大導師（Grão-Mestre Adjunto），多次代理大導師。
body.en: The parliamentary note says that for much of the Republic he headed the General Administration of Posts and Telegraphs, working to build a radiotelegraph network in Portugal, which led to the Companhia Portuguesa Rádio Marconi in 1925; he was also Adjunct Grand Master of Freemasonry between December 1915 and December 1929 and stood in for the Grand Master on several occasions.
